title: Vielezi (Theme 2: Nidhamu mezani)
status: draft: written 18 Nov 2026 offline for Grade 4 Kiswahili; not yet checked by a native Kiswahili teacher; not loaded by the live tutor

skills.key_step: The child asks which question the word answers (lini? wapi? vipi?) about the action.

floor.prerequisite: Finds the verb in a sentence.
floor.question: Kitenzi ni kipi: "Tulifika jana."

representations: three question cards: lini, wapi, vipi
a sentence strip with the adverb covered
steps: Ask lini, wapi or vipi about it.
The word that answers is the adverb.

board.do: Wait for the child to answer before saying anything.
The child writes two sentences: one with an adverb of time, one of place.

misconceptions.ask: Soma tena: "Wanafunzi wanaimba ___ darasani." Kwa nini "nzuri" si jibu sahihi?
misconceptions.repair: Kielezi kinaonyesha jinsi kitendo kinavyofanyika: wanaimba vizuri. "Nzuri" ni kivumishi cha nomino.

misconceptions.ask: Soma tena: "Mtoto alikimbia ___ kuelekea nyumbani." Kwa nini "barabara" si jibu sahihi?
misconceptions.repair: "Haraka" ni kielezi cha jinsi. "Barabara" ni nomino.

misconceptions.ask: Soma tena: "Kielezi "jana" kinaonyesha ___." Kwa nini "mahali" si jibu sahihi?
misconceptions.repair: Vielezi vya wakati (jana, kesho), mahali (hapa, mbali) na jinsi (polepole, haraka) vinajibu "lini", "wapi" na "vipi".
Shuleni hujibu swali "wapi?": ni kielezi cha mahali.
